description: A Java class for loading and observing Cobalt storage files from the file system, including methods for reading storage blobs, validating headers, and setting file observers.

classes.name: CobaltStorageLoader
classes.description: Main class to load Cobalt storage from the file system and manage storage observers.

classes.name: CobaltStorageLoader.CobaltStorageObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing changes in Cobalt storage.

classes.name: CobaltStorageLoader.StorageFileObserver
classes.description: Internal class extending FileObserver to monitor storage file changes.

methods.name: CobaltStorageLoader
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a directory for storage files.

methods.name: loadStorageSnapshot
methods.description: Reads the current storage snapshot from the file system.

methods.name: setObserver
methods.description: Sets a storage observer to be notified on storage changes.

methods.name: loadStorageFile
methods.description: Loads and parses a storage file into a Storage proto message.

methods.name: getStorageBlob
methods.description: Reads the storage blob data from a file.

methods.name: getStorageFileName
methods.description: Finds the storage file name in the directory.

methods.name: isStorageFile
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches storage file naming pattern.
